lyrics:
[intro]
Yeah, yeah...
From day one, side by side.
Dreams get bigger when the team stays alive.
Let's ride.
[verse]
Started with a vision, nothing but a spark,
Late nights grinding while the city's going dark.
Every setback only made us stand tall,
When one of us slipped, the others answered the call.
No shortcuts, no fear, just another climb,
Building every moment, one day at a time.
Through the pressure and the doubt, we never fold,
Turning every story into something bold.
[chorus]
Hands up, we're chasing the skyline,
You and I, we're running on the same time.
No matter how the road may bend,
Real ones stay until the end.
Dreams grow higher every mile,
Every struggle makes it worthwhile.
Together we rise, together we stand,
Future's waiting—we're taking command.
[verse]
Different paths, but the mission stays the same,
Every lesson added fuel into the flame.
No looking back, we keep our focus clear,
Every victory started right here.
Laugh through the chaos, fight through the pain,
Sun after every storm, we'll shine again.
The world keeps spinning, so we keep the pace,
Leaving our mark in every place.
[chorus]
Hands up, we're chasing the skyline,
You and I, we're running on the same time.
No matter how the road may bend,
Real ones stay until the end.
Dreams grow higher every mile,
Every struggle makes it worthwhile.
Together we rise, together we stand,
Future's waiting—we're taking command.
[bridge]
When the lights get low, we lift each other higher,
Hope keeps burning like an endless fire.
No fear can break what we've become,
Our greatest days are still to come.
[chorus]
Hands up, we're chasing the skyline,
You and I, we're running on the same time.
No matter how the road may bend,
Real ones stay until the end.
Dreams grow higher every mile,
Every struggle makes it worthwhile.
Together we rise, together we stand,
Future's waiting—we're taking command.
[outro]
Yeah... this is more than a dream.
More than a moment.
It's the family we chose.
Keep moving. Keep believing.
See you at the top.
